decisive_items: declined SARS-CoV-2 vaccination earlier in pregnancy
1 week of dyspnea, cough, chest pain, and headache
response.rationale: Pregnant unvaccinated patient with viral respiratory symptoms, mild thrombocytopenia/transaminitis, elevated D-dimer, and severe respiratory failure requiring ECMO strongly favors COVID-19 pneumonia. The tubular clot is on the ECMO cannula, not direct evidence of primary pulmonary embolism.

rejected.why: TTP is unlikely with only mild thrombocytopenia, normal creatinine, no mention of hemolytic anemia or neurologic/renal involvement; hemoglobin is elevated rather than low.
Dyspnea, chest pain, and elevated D-dimer are nonspecific and also seen in COVID-19; the only described clot is an ECMO cannula complication, not a pulmonary embolus.
